description: This file defines the RedshiftServerlessClient class within the Aws\RedshiftServerless namespace. It provides method annotations for interacting with the Redshift Serverless service, indicating available API methods and their asynchronous counterparts. The class extends AwsClient, implying it inherits common AWS SDK client features.
